description: Swedish vocabulary register audit list. 'formal' = kanslisvenska/literary item dead in conversation; 'preferred' = what Swedish speakers actually say. Deck uses universal du (du-reformen); Ni as polite singular is a register error. Severity: 'high' = dead in speech, swap wherever it appears in conversational cards; 'medium' = written-leaning, swap in beginner content. See docs/swedish-register-policy.md.

dead_in_speech.rationale: Kanslisvenska and literary forms that never occur in modern conversation.

entries.note: Sign and legal negation («Ej i trafik»). Quoting signage is exempt; dialogue is always inte. icke- as a prefix (icke-rökare) is standard — exempt.
Archaic 'because'; survives only in hymns, old prose, and irony.
Report/academic connector; speech says alltså or så.
Bureaucratic 'by means of'; jocular use is intentional register play.
Post du-reformen, du is universal address. ni as genuine plural ('you all') is standard — exempt.
